resources.string: Unofficial app, not affiliated with Supercell.
Your personal key (send /scoutkey to the DeckMate bot in Telegram and paste it here):

How to use:
1. Save the key and tap Check.
2. Pull down the quick settings shade, tap the pencil and drag the DeckMate tile into it.
3. On the battle loading screen tap the tile. The first time Android asks to allow screen capture: choose "Entire screen" and Start now.
4. The opponent's deck arrives in the Telegram bot.

Permissions: Internet (to send the screenshot), screen capture (only when you allow it, only on your tap), notification (shows that capture is on; Stop button inside). The screenshot is kept in memory only and is not saved.
Sent. Deck will arrive in Telegram.
Wrong key. Get a new one: /scoutkey
No key. Open the app and paste it.
Too fast. Wait a few seconds.
Takes a screenshot when you press both volume buttons together and sends it to the DeckMate bot. It does not read the screen content or other apps.

Fast mode (optional): press BOTH volume buttons at once to send a screenshot, no shade and no dialogs. Enable it once in Accessibility settings (Android warns about this permission: the service only takes a screenshot on your key press).
